messages:
maria: FYI — Garnet postmortem follow-up: during a weekday traffic spike their on-prem peering flapped and a software bug in our VPC-accept logic caused tenant isolation for ~16m. Need to land action items and owners.

samir: Ack. Can you paste the minimal repro / timeline here?

maria: TL;DR: peering ASN renegotiation from their router caused route churn. Our peering health check retried rapidly and hit a race in accept handler -> duplicate session created -> isolation. Timeline attached in postmortem doc (link).

elaine: Oof. recurring pattern with on-prem folks doing router OS upgrades and our side not handling transient ASN change. We should: 1) add backoff in accept path, 2) add stronger dedupe, 3) customer comms draft.

samir: I'll take the backoff + dedupe work. ETA end of sprint (2 weeks) unless someone argues for hotfix.

maria: Garnet is on Dedicated + Private peering and wants a timeline sooner. Can we do a targeted hotfix for the dedupe check first?

kevin: I can do the dedupe quick patch — small change in vpc-peer-accept. Estimate 2 days incl. test harness. After that we can roll a canary to staging and one customer.

samir: Sounds good. I'll own the backoff/backpressure change, longer task ~10d (includes perf tests).

maria: Assigning owners: @kevin = dedupe hotfix (2d). @samir = backoff/backpressure + tests (10d). @elaine = cust comms + runbook updates (1d).

elaine: Draft comms: short apology, impact summary, what we changed, timeline for follow-up. I'll ping legal if needed.

devops-bot: Incident created: GARNET-ISO-2026. Severity: P2. Assigned: kevin, samir.

kevin: Quick note — dedupe hotfix will add this check to the accept path:```python
# pseudo
if session.id in active_sessions:
  log("duplicate session, dropping")
  return
```
I will include a metric (peer.dedupe.count) and an alert when it increases > 5/min.

samir: For backoff plan: exponential backoff on peering health retries, cap retries per minute, and ensure route flaps don't trigger immediate reconnection. Need to ensure we don't violate any SLA windows.

maria: Also we found an isolation-bug pattern across 3 customers in last 6 months — they all involve transient ASN/router state changes. Can we add a recurring task to triage similar incidents monthly?

elaine: I'll add to our postmortem cadence: Monthly Isolation Patterns review. Invite: eng-infra, eng-runtime, support, solutions.

kevin: Plan for canary: staging -> beta-customer -> Garnet. If dedupe patch looks clean in canary, we push to Garnet next maintenance window (Tue 02:00 UTC).

samir: Test matrix: peering flaps, ASN change, rapid reconnects, and simulated graceful router restart. I'll add tests to CI and integration harness.

maria: Thanks. Action items summary: \n- kevin: dedupe hotfix + metric + canary (owner, 2d)\n- samir: backoff/backpressure + tests + perf (owner, 10d)\n- elaine: customer comms + runbook + schedule monthly triage (owner, 1d)\n- maria: coordinate Garnet maintenance window + post-release verification (owner, 3d)

kevin: Starting work now, will post PR link.

devops-bot: PR #4827 opened by kevin in infra/vpc-peer-accept. CI: queued.

maria: One request from Garnet — can we provide a short runbook snippet they can use when they do router upgrades so it reduces churn on our side? Maybe a checklist.

elaine: I'll draft a 6-step checklist and attach to comms.

kevin: PR passed CI, deploying to staging canary in 30m.

samir: I'll review the PR later today and start planning the backoff change.

maria: Great. Let's reconvene in 48h for status and to confirm canary results. :thumbsup:
